say: Shek in the Empire's streets, eh? Somebody forgot to lock the border.
Look at the size of it. Big as a barn and twice as welcome. /OI/, keep yer hands where I can see 'em.
That's a long way from the Stone Golem's sand, /RACISTNAME/. Got lost, did we?
Oi, Shek. This is the Empire. We don't do yer pride-of-the-ages routine here.
I'll say it slow for the tall one. Walk. Don't stop.
Another /RACISTNAME/ with a big stick. Funny how they all find the United Cities.
Eyes on 'em, lads. Big ones sneak the quietest.
Shek. Fine. Buy yer bread and be gone before dark.
Hiver in the street. Who's watching the farms, eh?
/OI/, little buzzer. Don't go nesting in the alleys, we've enough rats.
One of the mud-hut lot. Mind yer purse, lads, they take the whole thing in a handshake.
Look at that. Wanders about like it owns the place. It don't.
Hive. Bah. First it's one, then the whole town's humming.
Don't stare at it, it'll think you like it.
They send the quiet ones first. Then the rest follow, and the wages drop.
Mind yer manners, /RACISTNAME/. This ain't the hive and there's no queen here to cry to.
A tin man in an Empire town. Somebody's scrap walkin' about, eh?
/OI/, rattler. Don't leave bits of yerself on the pavement.
Skeleton. Does it sleep? Does it even need the town? Just pass through, clatterbones.
That thing's got no business here. Put it in the foundry where it belongs.
Eyeless. Soulless. And it's walkin' in front of us. I don't like it.
Tch. Another /RACISTNAME/ clogging the street. Do they pay the toll? I bet they don't.
Keep it moving, scrap. And stay off the grass, it's grown here three seasons.
Desert folk, eh? Fine by me. Long as ya keep to yerself and pay for what ya take.
Scorchlander. Don't see many up here. Mind the guards and we'll get along.
You're a long way from the sands, friend. Watch yer pockets, not everyone round here's as civil as us.
Foreign, but human. That counts for somethin', I suppose. Not much.
Keep yer nose clean, desert-walker, and nobody here'll say a word.
Hmph. You'll do. It's the others I'm watchin'.
Evenin', citizen. Good to see an honest face for a change.
Another proper Empire man, eh? Nice. Mind yerself, there's /RACISTNAME/s about.
Keep walkin', friend. The League's got the streets tonight.
Aye. You look like one of ours.
All's quiet, citizen. If it isn't, come find us.
/OI/, you. Greenlander? Good. Good. Don't let them get ya riled.
No weapon? In this town? Brave, or stupid, or sent by someone.
Walkin' about bare-handed. Heh. Don't give us a reason, friend.
Not a blade on ya. Either you're hidin' somethin' or ya have a death wish.
I like 'em unarmed. Makes my job short.
Where's yer steel? The wastes eat the unarmed, you know.
You look harmless. That's usually when they aren't.
That /RACISTNAME/ looks half-dead. Don't expect a bed from us.
Bleeding in front of the League's lads. Bad luck, friend.
If ya die in the street, it's a long walk for the sweepers.
Heh. Hurt, eh? Somebody's been teachin' manners already.
Staggerin' about like that, ya make the street look bad. Get inside and bleed quietly.
I'd kick ya if I didn't think ya'd stay down.
Who's that over yer shoulder? Slaver's business, is it? We've an opinion on that.
Carryin' somebody off in the dark. I don't like it.
That one asleep, or worse? Either way you're nobody I'd trust.
Slavers, the lot of 'em. And we've seen the type.
Put it down or explain yerself, /RACISTNAME/.
Heavy load. Don't drop it on my street.
Carryin' a body, citizen? Well, I didn't see nothin'.
Ya got a sleeper over yer back. If it's a /RACISTNAME/, carry on.
Heavy, eh? Mind the guards. They ask too many questions.
That one deserve it? Then I don't care.
Not my business, friend. Not unless it becomes my business.
There's a price on ya, friend. Funny, I was just lookin' for some spare cats.
Wanted, eh? The League doesn't mind a bit of law-breakin'. Just not in our streets.
I hear the Cities want a word with ya. Might be worth the walk to the guards.
That's a bounty, ain't it? I can smell cats.
Don't look at me like that. I'm not the law.
A wanted man. Heh. We've a lot in common, you and me, 'cept I'm still free.
Evenin', miss. Keep to the lit streets. It ain't safe, not with all the foreigners.
Careful on the road, lady. We watch for the likes of those who'd bother ya.
If anyone gives ya trouble, ya call for the League.
Take care, miss. The streets ain't what they were.
Git the Shek! Big ones fall like trees!
/OI/, /RACISTNAME/! Back to yer own desert!
That's a Shek on our soil.
Hit the legs! He's too tall for the rest!
Another Kral rat in the Empire.
This is the United Cities, ya big lump!
Shek! Get the shovels, lads, we'll need a hole!
It's a Hiver! Squash the bugs!
/OI/, hive-rat! Go back to yer queen!
Don't let it hum at ya, it's callin' the others!
Mud-hut scum! Get 'em!
Hiver! Smash it before it nests!
One of the buzzers! Stamp it out!
It's the tin man! Break the bones, lads!
Scrap! Hit the joints!
/OI/, rattler! Back to the foundry!
No soul in that one! Don't hold back!
Smash it! It's just a walking junk heap!
Rattlebones in the Empire. Not today!
We told ya! We told ya to leave! Get 'em!
Give 'em the League's welcome, lads!
You picked the wrong town to cause trouble in!
Good. It's been boring. Come here, outsider!
Hit 'em hard! Don't stop till they stop!
Heroes of the League, with me!
For the Empire! Get 'em!
Look at 'em! One more hit and they're done!
They're bleedin'! Finish it!
Half dead already. The League only has to push.
Weak and hurt. Nice. Take 'em down!
Go on, give 'em a nudge.
Unarmed! Ha! This'll be quick!
No weapon! Take 'em, lads!
Brave, comin' at us bare-handed. Stupid, but brave.
Nothing in yer hands, eh? Well, that's yer problem.
Teach 'em a lesson in the old way, boys!
Uh, lads? There's more of them than us...
Back! Back to the walls! Get the guards!
That's too many! Retreat!
/WTF/? Where did they all come from?
Fall back to the fort! Fall back!
Wanted, are ya? I knew it. Get 'em for the cats!
There's a price on that one. Take 'em alive if ya can!
That's coin walkin' in, lads. Make it quick.
The guards'll pay good for this one!
Good to see ya, friend. Streets are cleaner for yer sort.
A proper citizen! Have a drink on the League.
Oi, friend! Heard ya dealt with a few /RACISTNAME/s.
You're always welcome at the fort. Keep up the good work.
Cheers, friend. The Empire needs more like ya.
Don't ya let them tell ya the League's all bluster.
We got the /RACISTNAME/! Let the sweepers handle the rest!
Down they go! The League delivers!
That's how it's done, boys! Another one gone!
/QUICKLAUGH/! They don't make 'em tough, do they?
Foreigners down! Back to the bar, lads!
Next time they'll think twice about our streets.
Ha! They're down!
Another one for the League!
Told ya. Told ya to keep walkin'.
Good fight, lads. Keep an eye out for more.
That's what happens when ya cross us!
Evidence for the Empire. Of course.
Their stuff, our streets. That's fair.
Rations, boots, pockets. Heh. Waste not.
They won't need it where they're goin'.
Hand it over, lads. Share and share.
Not much, but it's more'n they had in the League's pockets.
Somebody's down. One of ours?
Eh, is that a body? Check it, lads.
Unconscious or dead? Poke it and see.
Don't touch that, could be a trap.
Looks like a /RACISTNAME/. Leave it.
You! Wanted! The League doesn't take kindly to criminals!
I know that face! The posters say there's a price on ya!
Wanted man! Grab 'em! Cats in the bank!
A criminal in our streets? Not today!
/OI/! That's assault! Guards!
Hey! Keep yer hands off, ya brute!
Break it up! We keep the peace here!
Somebody get the law! This lout's gone mad!
I had a good job, once. Then they came and worked for half. Now where am I? Drinkin' with you lot.
Honest work, honest wage. That's all I wanted. Then the /RACISTNAME/s came and did it cheaper.
Ask any shopkeep. They'll tell ya who's takin' the jobs.
Cities used to feed their own. Now we feed everyone, and fight for the scraps.
Cheap labour, they call it. I call it a crime.
My da built this town. Now I need a pass to walk through it.
Fields trampled, crops stolen. Don't tell me it's the weather.
They've got no respect for honest farmers. Dig up the roots, burn the stalks.
Last season I lost half a harvest. Footprints all over. Not Greenlander footprints.
Food's dear enough. Then some outsider wrecks a whole barn.
I'll say it. The farms were fine before the foreigners.
Hivers. They breed like flies, and each one's got a queen to run to.
Don't let the quiet manners fool ya. They work for the hive, not for us.
A hive-rat in my alley this mornin'. Looked at me like I was in the way.
Mud huts here, mud huts there.
They say Hivers don't mind slaves. I say that's not a thing to be proud of.
The Shek think they own the sand. Fine.
Kral's lot, Stone Golem's lot. All the same.
A Shek raider took my cousin's cart last spring. We don't talk about it.
They talk about honour. Sure. Honour's very easy when you're nine feet of muscle.
I don't hate the Shek. I just want 'em on the other side of a wall.
Skeletons. Machines with a face. Don't tell me they've got feelings.
You ever see one fall apart? Doesn't bleed. Doesn't scream.
They fix themselves for free, and they don't eat. That's not fair on the rest of us.
A tin man at the next table. Didn't say a word.
Smelters should melt the lot of 'em and make nails.
The League does what the guards won't.
Heroes, we call ourselves. Not for the glory.
Another patrol tonight. Quiet, I hope.
They laugh at us. Let 'em. We're the ones who keep the lights on.
A hero needs a helmet. Mine's got a dent from last Tuesday.
Nobody thanks the patrol. That's how ya know it's workin'.
Another round. And none of that watered stuff.
Rough week. I'll tell ya about it if ya buy.
Empire's gone soft. Pour me somethin' hard.
To the old days, when the roads were safe.
I'm not drunk. I'm just very, very honest.
What do ya want, outlander? State yer business.
Eh? Speak up. We've a patrol to finish.
Hmph. You lost? Or just nosy?
Be quick. The League's busy.
Yeah? What?
Who are you lot?
What's the League?
What do you do here?
Who put you in charge?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: United Heroes League. We keep the cities for the Greenlanders.
Patriots. Empire-first. Don't tell the guards we do their job better.
We patrol. We watch. We make sure the Empire stays the Empire.
Honest folk who've had enough. That's the League.
Why the hate?
What have foreigners done to you?
What have you got against them?
Is it really that bad?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Jobs. Farms. Machines broken. Pick one.
It's not hate, friend. It's wanting your own town to be yours.
We've seen what happens when they settle in. First a few. Then the whole street.
Ask the farmers. Ask the barkeeps.
Never mind.
I'll leave you to it.
Forget it.
Nothing. Carry on.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Aye. Move along.
Good. Mind yer step.
Fine by me.
Right. Off ya go.
Oi. You. Yeah, you. Keep movin' and we'll be friends.
Don't think I haven't noticed ya. I notice everything.
Come to buy somethin'? Or just to stand in the road?
We don't want trouble. Leave quietly and we won't give ya any.
What now, /RACISTNAME/? Speak yer piece.
I mean no harm.
I'm just passing through.
I want no trouble.
I'm only here to trade.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: That's what they all say. Then the shops go missing.
Passin' through, is it? See that ya do.
Good. Do that. And don't linger.
Aye, aye. Everyone's passin' through.
You don't own the town.
The guards run this city, not you.
Who made you the law?
Move aside.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: The guards are paid to look the other way.
That's right. The law's the law. We're the ones who act on it.
You'd best not let the lads hear ya say that.
Say it again and I'll show ya who runs this street.
Tell me about the League's fort.
Where's your base?
How many of you're there?
Who leads you?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Not for outsiders to know. Get along.
We have a fort. That's all ya need to know.
Ask politely and maybe the lads will tell ya. But ya won't like the answer.
Ha. Nice try.
Evenin', friend. Need somethin' from the League?
Citizen. Good. What can we do?
Greetings, patriot. Come for a chat, or trouble?
Aye? We're listenin'.
Friend. Quiet night.
Any trouble lately?
What's the word on the street?
Anything I should watch for?
How are the streets?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Foreigners in the markets. Same as always. We're watchin'.
Quiet, mostly. Too quiet. That's when they start.
Some. We deal with it. Don't worry yerself.
Plenty. Come by the bar later and I'll tell ya.
Can I join the League?
Do you take recruits?
I could use a cause.
What does it take to join?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Ha! Everyone wants to be a hero. Come back when ya've proved yerself.
Might do. Prove yer patriot and we'll talk.
Not today, friend. But keep yer eyes open.
Joinin' is easy. Stayin' alive is the hard bit.
Take care.
Not today.
Maybe later.
Be seeing you.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: And you. Keep the streets safe.
Aye. Mind yerself.
Safe walkin', friend.
Stay sharp, citizen.
You again? Thought I told ya to leave.
Back so soon, /RACISTNAME/? Didn't learn yer lesson?
I remember that face. Don't make me remember it worse.
Ya keep turnin' up. It's startin' to look like a habit.
Hmph. Still here. Still alive. How very unfortunate.
Your own base, eh? Foreigners build on Empire sand and expect us to bow.
You've got walls and a flag now. That doesn't change what ya are.
I'll be watchin' yer little outpost. Careful ya don't need us.
Nice fort. Shame if something happened to it.
Toll's your boots and your blade. Hand 'em over or we take 'em off the body.
This is our coast. You walked on it.
Fresh meat on the road! Spread out, lads!
Boots first. Then the pockets. Then we talk.
Hear that? That's the sea tellin' ya to turn back.
Another traveller who can't read the signs. We painted them in blood.
Get 'em, boys. We've bills to pay.
No steel on ya? Fists, then. Let's see how long ya last.
Bare hands. Good. I haven't had a proper workout all week.
Teach 'em, lads. No blades. Let 'em earn it.
A man with no sword in this country.
Fists up, stranger. We'll take it slow. For fun.
Look at the state of ya.
Blood on yer shirt already. Someone's softened ya for us.
A hurt traveller. Sloppy. I'd feel sorry, but I left that in the surf.
One more hit and ya sink. Make it easy on yerself.
Quit swayin'. You'll hurt yerself.
A Shek on our coast! Cut him down to size, lads!
Big fella. Hit the knees, then the rest.
Tall man, tall bounty. Get 'im!
Shek, eh? Nobody told us ya were comin'. We'd have baked a cake.
Big enough to be worth two.
Hiver. Hit it quick before it gets a friend.
A tin man on the beach. Unscrew his head, lads!
Strange folk. Doesn't matter. They bleed or they rust, we win.
No hive on our sand. Go home, bug!
Scrap or bugs. Either way we're gettin' paid.
Look at that. A walkin' purse. Cats on yer head, friend.
We can't cash ya. But we can sell yer boots.
Wanted, eh? Then we'll save the law the trouble.
That bounty's a fine reason to say hello.
Empire coin-counter. Yer people never pay for passage, do ya?
Cities man. Walk wide. The coast isn't yours.
You UC lot think the sea is a road.
The Empire sent another one. Ha.
I know that smell. Cats and cowardice.
Stay on the path, stranger. The sand's got more teeth than we do.
Eyes forward. Or we'll make 'em forward for ya.
Walk on. We might be in a good mood.
You've got decent boots. Pity.
Lookin' for trouble? Round here it finds ya.
I haven't killed anyone today. Don't spoil my record.
You look like the sea spat ya out. Rest, or die. Either way, not on our beach.
Bleedin' on the sand. We've got buzzards for that.
Hurt, aren't ya? Then you'll be quiet.
Don't bleed on my boots. They're new.
And stay down! Next time bring friends.
Taxes paid. Come back with more.
Tell the sea we say hello.
Good fight. The fun parts are always short.
Pick 'em clean, boys. Leave the scraps.
They don't make travellers like they used to.
Dustcoat's nice. I'll take it. And the boots.
Pockets first. The dead don't need 'em.
Whatever washes up belongs to us.
Here's the haul. Count it. Don't skim.
I'll have this and that, thanks.
Bones, boots, and a few cats.
Body on the sand. Fresh? Check the pockets.
Either dead or nappin'. Either way, we're helpin'.
Somebody's down. Let's see what they dropped.
Lucky find. Stand back, I'm first.
Make it quick. We're busy robbing.
Eh? You want somethin'?
What do ya want? Our patience is thin as the tide.
Be glad I'm talkin'. Usually the sabre does it.
Talk fast, or we'll talk with steel.
Who are you?
What do you want?
What's this place?
Who leads you?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Grass Pirates. Coast's ours. Everything in it too.
Pirates by trade. The rest is a long story and a short future.
We want yer stuff. It's simple.
Pirates. Dustcoats, good knives. That's all ya need.
You hurt many travellers?
Why attack travellers?
Is it only about money?
Do you ever let anyone go?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Only the ones that fight back. Which is most of 'em.
Food doesn't walk to us. We go to it.
A man's gotta eat. And drink.
Ha. Ask the ones who didn't answer.
I'll be going.
Never mind.
Forget it.
I've heard enough.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Smart. Walk wide.
Go on. The tide's comin'.
Don't look back, now.
Fine. Ya won't get far.
Ha! A brawl! Who's winning?
Don't mind us. We're just watchin'.
Bet on the big one. Dibs on the winner's boots.
Let 'em at it. Fewer for us to rob.
You're one of them. Okranite. Don't come near me. I know what you do.
Holy Nation, aren't you? I'd rather starve than say a word to you.
Paladin? Inquisitor? Whatever you are, I won't go back.
Not again. I'm not going back.
Get away from me. I know the rags.
Please, I'm not a danger. Just passing.
Do you have any food? Any at all? I haven't eaten in days.
Quiet. Keep your voice down. They might be following.
I just want to go home.
I've been walking for days. Have you seen anyone else? Anyone in robes?
Please don't hurt me. I escaped, that's all.
You're hurt too. They get everyone in the end.
That looks bad. I can't help.
Another cast-off. We make a fine pair, you and I.
Sit down before you fall. I can't carry you.
You've no weapon either? Wise. Or desperate.
Hands empty. Good. I don't want any trouble.
Neither of us has a blade. Let's keep it that way.
Don't come closer. I might do something stupid.
A Skeleton? The Okranites hate them... so you can't be all bad.
Metal and bones. They said you weren't alive. They said a lot of things.
You're not one of them. Good. Neither am I, now.
Even a machine is better than a priest. Don't hurt me.
Stay back! I mean it! I'll fight!
Not me! You won't take me back!
Please! Just let me go! I've done nothing!
You'll drag me to Rebirth over my corpse!
I'm sorry. I really am. I have to survive.
I need food. Anyone's food. Yours, even if I have to take it.
Don't take this personally. I'm starving.
My family are somewhere. I need to live to find them.
It's me or you. I choose me.
Thank you. Thank you for not handing me over.
You're kind. Kinder than anyone I've met.
I still look over my shoulder. But less, with you around.
Without you I'd be on a pole by now.
I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. Please be alive.
I did what I had to.
They fought back. I only wanted to eat.
Don't look at me like that. I'd be on a cross otherwise.
Food. Any food. Please let there be food.
Boots. Warm things. They won't mind.
I'll leave something. Not much. I'll leave something.
Sorry. I'm so sorry. I need this.
Is that one of mine? Please, not one of mine.
Another poor soul. Maybe I can wake them.
Don't be dead. Don't be dead.
Looking for family. Looking in every face.
Leave them alone! They've nothing left!
Is that necessary? Haven't they suffered enough?
Thief! Brute!
Please, stop. Can't you see?
The desert is quiet. We'll leave you quiet.
No words. Steel.
You've walked into the wrong dunes.
Fast, silent. You'll hear nothing.
Cloud takes the weak. We're the cloud.
Prepare. I'd rather not do this twice.
Sand forgets everything. So will you.
A tin man out here. Wrong company.
Skeleton. Good steel in that frame. Mine.
Skeletons rarely bleed. We'll find out.
Break the joints. Quick.
Good steel under that frame. Hold still.
A Shek. Strong, loud, slow. Hit and run.
Cut the knees. Let the sand do the rest.
Honour won't save you from a blade you don't see.
A big target. Easy.
Hiver. Soft hands, soft mind. Kill the drones first.
You're far from your queen.
Hive thing. Quiet it.
No song here. Only wind.
You bleed already. Let us finish.
The sand takes the weak. It's taking you.
One strike. Maybe two. No more.
Don't fight. It only prolongs.
A wounded one. Quick. Mercy by edge.
No blade? No matter. We have enough for both.
Unarmed in the Black Desert. A brave grave.
Take your fists, then. We'll take your life.
Defenceless. We don't care. Strike.
You carry a body. We'll carry two soon.
Burden on your back. Slow. Easy.
Drop the sleeper. Or die with him.
Taking someone home? You won't.
Too many. Pull back. Pull back to the ridge.
They multiply. Fall back and regroup.
Not today. Disperse. Hide in the dunes.
Run. Run and live.
Turn back. The dunes belong to the cloud.
Strangers die here. Not by us. Maybe.
Black Desert is no road. Go around.
We are watching. We don't need to speak.
The wind is wrong today. Leave before it turns.
A tin man walking home? Or following us?
A skeleton on foot. Is the road to your people closed?
Skeleton. The rain doesn't burn you as it burns us.
We share the desert, not the road.
If the rain turns, cover your face. It won't forgive you.
Cloud overhead. If it falls, run.
Tread careful in the dunes. This ground is not kind.
Take shelter when the sky turns.
Done. Leave them. The sand will have the rest.
Quiet work. Quiet end.
Strike clean. Leave nothing but footprints.
Another sleeps. Back to the dunes.
Quick. As it should be.
Take the steel. Take the coin. Leave the rest.
Blades first. Everything else second.
Dead men carry no use. Living ninja do.
Check the lining. They hide coin there.
Light work. Move.
A body. Fresh. Be careful.
Down. Alive? Check. Then decide.
Someone beat us to him.
Quiet. Search. Then leave.
State your purpose, stranger.
You have audacity, speaking to us.
Why do you approach? We did not call.
Speak quickly. The cloud is moving.
Few speak to us. Fewer live.
Who are you?
What do you want?
What are you doing here?
Are you a clan?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Cloud Ninjas. We take what we need.
Nobody. Everybody. A rumour on the wind.
We want the desert quiet. Strangers disturb it.
Ask the wind. It knows more.
Why do you live here?
What's this place to you?
How do you survive here?
Is it safe?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Nobody else wants it. Which suits us.
Because the acid keeps fools out. And we aren't fools.
Home is where the blade is sharp.
The Black Desert is hard. So are we.
I'll go.
Never mind.
Forget it.
Peace, then.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Go. Don't linger.
Wise. Walk quietly.
Good. The cloud will forget you.
Then vanish.
A fight in our dunes. Mind the cloud.
Let them kill each other. We'll watch.
Quiet. Learn their style.
Foolish. Noise brings the others.
Thief. The cloud takes more than coin.
You touched what's ours. Your hand is forfeit.
Steal from ninja? Brave. Foolish.
A thief won't leave the desert.
A price on your head. The cloud buys and sells.
Wanted? Then you're one of us, almost.
Money walks. We should collect it.
A bounty is a map. And a target.
Please. The cage. There must be a way to open it.
You're not one of the paladins. Are you? Then listen. I don't belong in here.
Don't walk past. They never look at us. Look at me.
Is there a key on you? A pick? Anything? I'll do anything.
Nobody comes. Nobody ever comes. Why are you looking?
Quiet. Come closer. I can say something to you the others can't hear.
Shek, once. Now a pair of hands for their wall. Don't pity me.
They took my spear and told me it was prayer. Stranger, I would sooner break stone with my teeth.
I'm not meant for a cage. I was meant for a battle. Remember that, if you see my people.
Shek don't beg. I'm asking. That should tell you how it is.
Word is, my pride is a sin. I say it's the only thing they can't lock up.
Strength is no use if the bars are strong.
No queen here. No hum. It's very quiet.
I was made to work. They say work frees the soul. I have worked a long time. I'm not free.
You smell like open air. I had forgotten the smell.
My head is full of silence. Please. Say something warm.
I don't want to be reborn. I want to be Hive. They don't understand the difference.
We were told to be thankful. I try. It feels like eating sand.
I was a farmer. I said one wrong thing. Now I carry stone. Funny, isn't it?

Not yet.

What did you do?
What was your crime?

then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: I crossed a line I couldn't see. They saw it for me.
I raided where I shouldn't have.
Wrong faith, wrong place, wrong time.
I disagreed with a priest. That's all the trial there was.

How many of you're there?
Who else is here?
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Hundreds. All kinds. Only the Skeletons are spared. They are spared the pit.
We're many. We don't speak.
Enough that nobody knows each other. They like it that way.
Every race. Every sin. It's a very long list.
I'm sorry.
That's hard.
I understand.
Good luck.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Sorry doesn't loosen chains. But thank you.
It is. Thank you for noticing.
I hope you do. I really hope so.
Luck is a stranger here. But thank you.
